subject: Usage anomaly — provisional escrow credit & VAT evidence request
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cloudlytics.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: billing@cloudlytics.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Unexpected spike in July usage — request to pause collection and provisional credit

Hi Rohan,

We're seeing a sharp unexplained spike in token usage on July 27–30 for several internal services that route through Redwood. We believe ~560k tokens were double-counted due to what looks like a retry loop in one of our ingestion jobs. Attached is a short CSV with per-day usage (usage_report_aug-01-10.csv).

Can Redwood pause collection for invoice INV-202707-CL (due 2027-08-15) while we confirm? If the reconciliation confirms overbilling, we'd like a provisional (escrow) credit applied immediately to avoid disruption to our AP team.

Requested actions:
- Temporary hold on collection for INV-202707-CL
- A provisional credit equal to the overbilled amount (estimated €12,480) to be issued as an escrow credit
- Guidance on VAT documentation you need so we can send the right evidence

Happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Finance Operations
CloudLytics

Attachment: usage_report_aug-01-10.csv
From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cloudlytics.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in July usage — request to pause collection and provisional credit

Sofia — thanks for the heads up and for sending the CSV. We're pausing automated collection for INV-202707-CL now; AP holds are in place and the invoice will not be sent to collections while we investigate.

Next steps from our side:
- Monica (billing) will run a preliminary reconciliation and confirm the overcount.
- Laura (accounting) will estimate the provisional credit amount and prepare a credit memo draft.
- Vivek (finance) will approve placing the provisional amount into escrow pending audit.

Monica, Laura, Vivek — looping you in to drive the reconciliation. Monica, could you confirm the reconciliation ETA and if you need any further raw logs from CloudLytics?

I'll keep Sofia copied.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cloudlytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 08:36:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in July usage — request to pause collection and provisional credit

Hi all — I've run a preliminary pass against our call logs and the CloudLytics CSV. Early findings:
- There is a duplicated request pattern for 2027-07-27 22:00–23:30 UTC that correlates with your spike.
- Estimated duplicate token count: 560,350 tokens (rounded).
- Estimated overcharge (net of discounts): €12,480.00.

I attached a short PDF with the reconciliation summary (prelim_recon_813.pdf). For us to issue a VAT-compliant credit memo we need CloudLytics's EU VAT registration number and confirmation of their billing address to place on the credit. We also need to confirm whether you want the credit memo net of VAT or gross (i.e., inclusive of VAT).

Proposed provisional steps:
1) Place a provisional escrow credit for €12,480 against INV-202707-CL (status: PENDING_ESCROW).
2) Draft a credit memo and hold final issuance until you deliver VAT evidence and we complete a deeper audit (ETA 7 business days).
3) If internal audit confirms, we'll reissue a corrected invoice for the revised amount and release the escrow credit to your account balance.

Sofia — please send VAT number and billing address. If you'd like, we can also accept a signed DocuSign credit memo template to speed issuance.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: prelim_recon_813.pdf
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cloudlytics.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: billing@cloudlytics.com
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 14:50:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in July usage — request to pause collection and provisional credit

Thanks Monica and team — appreciate the fast turnaround.

VAT details below for your credit memo:
- VAT reg: EU987654321
- Billing address: CloudLytics B.V., Herengracht 123, 1015 BT Amsterdam, Netherlands
- We confirm we want the credit memo issued net of VAT (you should treat our account as VAT-reverse charge where applicable — happy to provide any local documentation if Redwood needs it).

I've attached the purchase order and a signed confirmation of the anomaly from our engineering manager. Also here is the PO link: https://cloudlytics.example.com/PO/88972 and a DocuSign link to a credit memo template: https://app.docusign.com/link/ABC12345PO

Attachments: PO-88972.pdf, eng_confirm_retry_log.txt

Sofia
From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@cloudlytics.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in July usage — request to pause collection and provisional credit

Sofia — quick update and confirmation of actions taken: 

1) Provisional escrow credit: We have placed a provisional escrow credit of €12,480.00 against INV-202707-CL. Status on our ledger: PENDING_ESCROW. This will prevent collection while we finish the audit.
2) Credit memo & invoice: Monica has drafted a credit memo; once we receive the signed DocuSign (or final VAT evidence) we'll finalize and issue the official credit memo (credit_memo_CL-88972.pdf) and reissue invoice INV-202707-CL (reissued_invoice_202708.pdf).
3) VAT treatment: We will register the credit memo net of VAT as requested; Laura will ensure the reverse-charge annotation is applied on the memo and keep GDPR-safe audit logs of the submitted VAT evidence.
4) Timeline: final audit expected by 2027-08-23. If all good, the escrow will be applied to your account balance and the reissued invoice delivered.

Sofia — thanks for the quick responses and the PO link. Monica/Vivek/Laura — please proceed with the draft credit memo and loop in legal if any unusual contract language is required.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: credit_memo_CL-88972.pdf, reissued_invoice_202708.pdf
